summary.problem: Adding control to video generation requires additional resources or architectural changes.
summary.method: A training-free approach using pretrained video diffusion models to control layout and motion through coarse visual guides.
summary.advance: Consistently outperforms prior work in overlap and trajectory accuracy, visual quality across settings.

summary.problem: Existing work lacks benchmarks for visual grounding in retinal OCT with MLLMs.
summary.method: RetinaGroundBench benchmark with AggIoU metric and RetGrounder model.
summary.advance: RetGrounder improves grounding F1 from 23.7% to 33.9% (43% relative improvement).

summary.problem: Existing streaming methods struggle with dynamic scenes, leading to pose drift and ghosting artifacts.
summary.method: Introduces Stream4D, a motion-decoupled streaming reconstruction framework using causal KV-cache attention.
summary.advance: Significantly improves camera pose estimation and static-scene reconstruction quality, effectively mitigates long-sequence ghosting.

summary.problem: Existing VLA-RL methods struggle with delayed and biased credit assignment and imbalanced subtask mastery in long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks.
summary.method: AtomicRL uses atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration, introducing SAPO and BATE.
summary.advance: Achieves up to 21.3% improvement in real-world task performance, significantly outperforming PPO on long-horizon tasks.

summary.problem: Existing trit-plane codecs treat decoded trits as discrete symbols for probability prediction, ignoring their role as interval constraints on continuous latents.
summary.method: Proposes bound-conditioned latent inference (BLI) that reformulates progressive trit-plane coding as sequential latent inference under shrinking interval constraints.
summary.advance: Achieves state-of-the-art rate-distortion performance, reducing BD-rate by 17.78% over DPICT and 7.96% over CTC on Kodak.

summary.problem: Existing GVC methods often rely on decoder-side diffusion models for denoising in latent space.
summary.method: ResGVC proposes residual coding that decomposes distortion into residual segments for direct pixel domain denoising.
summary.advance: ResGVC achieves 63.7% BD-rate reduction in LPIPS and 83.8% in PSNR, with superior visual quality.

summary.problem: Existing work struggles to reconstruct 3D room layouts from fMRI signals and camera trajectories.
summary.method: DRAFT decodes and reconstructs 3D room layouts using fMRI signals and camera trajectories, extracting a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex.
summary.advance: DRAFT achieves a layout r of 0.480 on held-out scenes, significantly outperforming existing methods and improving all seven decoders without retraining.

summary.problem: Existing work struggles with non-Markovian scenes in humanoid loco-manipulation, where cues vanish as objects change or are hidden.
summary.method: WholeBodyMem uses object-guided pre-history memory to keep key frames, improving policy success rates.
summary.advance: WholeBodyMem surpasses memoryless and uniform-memory baselines, raising success rates from 29.1% to 72.6% in simulation and 36.7% to 88.3% on the real robot.

summary.problem: Existing work segments entire objects as moving, failing to distinguish actual moving regions.
summary.method: MoRSe jointly interprets two frames to predict moving regions, distinguishing from camera-induced motion.
summary.advance: MoRSe outperforms specialized methods with fewer false positives, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

summary.problem: Improves inference efficiency and quality of future video representations in WAMs.
summary.method: Self-distillation with temporal context to improve future video representations from noise.
summary.advance: Significantly improves human-to-robot skill transfer, achieving 50.0% task success on unseen tasks.

summary.problem: Existing FUDA methods require multiple rounds of communication and struggle with noisy pseudo labels.
summary.method: SKD-ETR combines SKD and ETR to train a student model on the target domain with smoothed pseudo labels and refine source models via EMA.
summary.advance: SKD-ETR achieves competitive performance with one-shot training, reducing communication and computation overhead.

summary.problem: Existing work overlooks structural fidelity, cross-dataset robustness, and application-specific error costs in model selection.
summary.method: Evaluated five retinal vessel segmentation pipelines on six datasets using multiple metrics and error modes.
summary.advance: FSG-Net and SA-UNetv2 are optimal in different settings, highlighting the need for task-conditioned pipeline selection.

summary.problem: Existing methods lack kinodynamic modeling and safety distances, leading to high yaw rates, frequent collisions, and low success rates.
summary.method: Introduces KinoUAV, a kinodynamic benchmark with hierarchical trajectory generation and directional free-space distance labels.
summary.advance: Achieves highest success rate (90%) while maintaining lower yaw rates and collision rates.

summary.problem: Existing work trains world models to predict pixels, not improving policies.
summary.method: DRILL: A bilevel framework that updates world models to maximize policy utility.
summary.advance: DRILL-IMG raises mean success rate by 13.1 points over WMPO and 7.9 points over RLVR-World.

summary.problem: Lack of systematic survey on RS vision-language datasets and guidelines for fine-tuning and evaluation.
summary.method: Systematic review and practical guide for constructing high-quality RS vision-language datasets.
summary.advance: Encourages building diverse and higher-quality datasets for RS sub-fields, laying a data foundation for general AI in RS.

summary.problem: Existing work focuses on generating more facts in captions, ignoring where facts appear.
summary.method: Introduces position-aware rubric representation and PAGER objective for reinforcement learning.
summary.advance: Improves position-wise grounding and pairwise caption preference, preserving global quality.

summary.problem: Existing fusion methods integrate modality-specific and cross-modal interactions into joint representations, making it difficult to determine standalone and interaction-conditioned predictive utility.
summary.method: I$^2$-KAN, a multi-pathway framework that maintains intra-modal and inter-modal information separately, learns compact task-relevant representations, and fuses them with explicit pathway associations.
summary.advance: Strong overall performance on benchmarks, showing that a modality's standalone predictive utility does not necessarily imply its interaction-conditioned utility, highlighting the interaction-dependent nature of multimodal utility.

summary.problem: Existing work limits LoRA adaptation to a single pretrained backbone.
summary.method: Proposes LoRA superposition summing independent LoRAs across different pretrained backbones.
summary.advance: Improves accuracy by 30.21 percentage points on average, matching solo LoRAs closely.

summary.problem: Joint forecasting of human motion and 3D pose is challenging, especially in team sports with complex social dynamics.
summary.method: Unified socio-temporal encoder that fuses and models trajectory and pose jointly through shared factorized attention.
summary.advance: Improves pose accuracy by 10% on 3DPW and 20% on WorldPose, largest gains over prior methods.

summary.problem: Self-supervised Vision Transformers produce unreliable patch-level representations for dense prediction tasks.
summary.method: CODI mixes teacher class-token distribution into each teacher patch-token target to provide masked patches with global semantics.
summary.advance: CODI improves both dense and image-level performance on benchmarks, outperforming prior work.
